pluginText.pf.messages: {"displayName":"a switch: the practice texts under a plain display name, like Lee Associates or Lee Family Services; card statements show it too","never":"client texts carry only the display name, the date, the time, the place and a secure link: never 'therapy', 'counseling', the kind of session, a reason, a diagnosis, a medicine name or a child's details; at the office, never the therapist's name (it's on the secure page); at home, the therapist's name and photo stay, for the door check; the video link stays on the secure page","staff":"texts to the owner and staff use the client's initials (A.M.), the time and a link: never health details, diagnoses, medicine names or a child's details; a client's question or crisis words go behind a link, never quoted","safeContact":"the client says if texts and voicemail are safe; if not, Rosie reaches them only the way they pick","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"a teen's texts go to the parent or guardian, unless the state's form lets the teen consent alone and the practice turns that on","noRatings":"no rating or review request is ever sent to a client","noAdvice":"Rosie gives no advice or counseling by text or chat; it answers only about booking"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each therapist's own license, per state, and any compact privilege; an associate's supervisor on file","skills":"who sees adults, teens, couples and families; who offers video and home sessions; who speaks which language; how each lists themselves (like a woman or a man) for clients who ask","supervision":"an associate works only under the supervisor the state's form sets (a switch)","oks":"the owner OKs same-day sessions, new clients where he turns that on, any custom price and every sliding-scale fee, and anything a therapist flags","standIn":"a client's therapist is never changed without the client's own yes; a stand-in is offered only with the same skills and what the client asked for, like a woman","crisis":"the owner, or the clinician the office's crisis rule names, gets crisis alerts at any hour","homeVisits":"only therapists cleared for home sessions go to homes"}

pluginText.pf.edges: {"crisis":"crisis words in any message, at any time, get 988 and 911 first, and alert the owner under the office's rule; the booking stays","lateArrival":"a late client is seen in the time left, and the session ends on time; no fee for running late","missedSession":"the therapist calls first; at home, a client who doesn't answer starts a safety check before any fee","standIn":"a therapist out: new times with the same therapist, or another only with the client's yes","forms":"forms not done: one reminder, then the owner keeps the session (signed first), moves it, or cancels with no fee","planChange":"the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay, or a free cancel","approvalRunsOut":"the plan's approved sessions run low: the desk is warned, and asks for more or tells the client the self-pay price","outOfState":"a video client who'll be in another state: only a therapist licensed there, another time, or a free cancel","twoBookings":"a client with several sessions booked: Rosie asks which one before any change","healthQuestion":"a question about what to do, or about medicine, goes to the therapist behind a link; Rosie gives no advice","weather":"home sessions move with no fee when ice or snow warnings make the roads unsafe","unsafeHome":"a therapist who feels unsafe at a home leaves (UNSAFE), and the owner calls","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
